results.title: MoneyGram International Launches a New Pilot on Stellar
How wallets and apps can reach cash users globally with MoneyGram
results.description: Join the Stellar Development Foundation and MoneyGram International on Wednesday, August 3, 2022 at 9:00 am PT for a discussion on the recently launched cash-to-crypto service, MoneyGram Ramps. Boris Reznikov, SDF's Senior Director of Partnerships, and Alicia Smith, MoneyGram as a Service Head of Product, will talk through what the launch of this first-of-its-kind service means, and what wallets that want to integrate with it need to know to get started. You’ll also have the opportunity to ask questions at the end of the presentation.
